flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The management targets bauxite volumes in the range of 10 to 12 million tons for the next year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "our target for the year after next is 15 million, and this year we are expecting broadly a range of 10 to 12 million tons for next year" (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management reiterated confidence in achieving the long-term volume target of 15 million tons for FY27-FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: Management plans to expand port facilities to increase volume capacity from 15 million tons to 20 million tons by the end of the year.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company is looking at a significant capex of roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions over the next year.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 18.4% earnings growth vs 34% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
A metals & mining tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management noted that aluminium metal is currently trading at about $3,600 and is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "As such, the metal is doing very good, aluminium metal currently is trading at about $3,600 which is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton and that will have again some positive impact on the consumption of bauxite in coming months." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the world can absorb up to 300 million tons of bauxites every year.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So, you can see that there will be some, initially there will be some gap between supply and demand, and over a time they will slowly they will fill up this gap." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 38% vs profit 34% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix with a higher proportion of lower-margin products.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Additionally, profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix, with a higher proportion of lower-margin products contributing to overall sales." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Within our portfolio, the performance of our Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices, which is a key raw material used in this business." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Prolonged monsoon in Guinea impacted operations and affected overall performance during the quarter.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The prolonged monsoon in Guinea had impacted our operations and affecting our overall performance." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Sep) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, opportunities carry equal weight (S28/W27/O28/T14), so the evidence does not favour one side.
